title: Browser audio: failures hang or become permanent instead of surfacing as errors
description:
In `web/src/audio/`:
- Render workers get no `onerror` or `onmessageerror` handler (`player.ts:82-90`). A wasm trap in a worker leaves the `waiting` promise and the `source-ready` waits pending forever.
- In the worklet, `instantiate(...).then(...)` has no catch (`engine-worklet.ts:31`), so `engineReady` never resolves on failure.
- `loadSources` stores each decode promise in `this.decoding` and never removes it on failure, so a failed decode can never be retried without a reload. Compare `peaks.ts:50` and `apricity.ts:126`, which delete the cache entry on rejection.
- `init()` caches `this.ready` (`player.ts:60`) even when it rejects, so a failed `addModule` or wasm fetch is permanent.

Done when: every worker and worklet failure rejects the waiting promise with a message, failed decode and init promises are evicted from their caches, and the play button shows the error. A test drives a worker error and asserts the player reports it and can recover.
